While I do think plate holders in general are terribly overpriced , and these are similarly expensive, these live up to the claims of the maker and then some. I have 1 8X10 that I use aggressively and other than needing a wipe between plates and a scrub at the end of the day, it has never let me down. 
The material used for the dark-slide is incredibly resilient - the same thing in a thin steel or aluminum could never take the various blows this one simply shrugs off and keeps working.
3D Print material has also come a long way and these things are tough and maintain shape and form cleanly. 
All in I have to say a terrific product made by someone who really wants to make good gear.
